author: Eervdtik

title: Great app to habit tracking and attractive design
body: I’ve been using this app for over a year now and couldn’t be happier!  I have tried many applications for tracking how many days passed since I quit smoking and drinking alcohol. A lot of them are functional but not beautiful in terms of design. This one is absolutely gorgeous! It’s simple and intuitive. The only thing I could suggest adding is showing years when you counted more than 365 days. Like 1 year and 3 days, for example. Other than that, great job to the team and keep it up!
author: RitzyArt
